Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Part A – Scope of Supply and Printing Requirements 1. The bid is for the supply of 60,000 (Sixty Thousand) Examination Answer Books conforming to the GeM category specifications selected in this bid.These Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC) sh all be read in conjunction with the GeM category specifications and shall not alter or supersede any prescribed technical specification. 2. Front Cover Page: The front cover page shall be printed in single colour (black) and shall contain t he following, in Hindi and English: (a) name of the Institute with the VAMNICOM logo; (b) title of the a nswer book and name of the examination; (c) boxes/fields for roll number, programme/course, subje ct, paper code and date of examination; (d) signature boxes for the candidate and the invigilator; (e) a table for question-wise marks awarded with total and examiner's signature; and (f) instructions to candidates and anything else as per the requirement of the Buyer. 3. The Institute shall provide the successful seller with the exact text, layout and print-ready artwork of the front cover page and the VAMNICOM logo, in soft-copy format, within one day from the date o f award of contract, covering the contents listed in Clause 2. The seller shall prepare the draft and reproduce the same exactly as provided, without any alteration in spelling, language, content, layou t or design. 4. Page Number and VAMNICOM Logo on Every Page: Every page of each Examination Answer B ook, from page 1 (front cover) to page 12 (back cover), shall carry a printed page number and the V AMNICOM logo, as under: (a) Page number: printed at the bottom centre of the page, in Arial font, 10 point size, black ink, in a continuous sequence from 1 to 12 in each answer book, without any missing, repeated or incorrectly printed number. (b) VAMNICOM logo: printed at the top right corner of the page, of size 15 mm x 15 mm, in a lig ht grey tint (approximately 20%) so that it does not interfere with writing. (c) On the front cover page, the page number and logo shall be positioned as per the artwork pro vided by the Institute under Clause 3. (d) Page numbers and logos shall not overlap, touch or interfere with the ruling lines, margins or writing area of the answer book. (e) Page numbers and logos shall be printed with ink of uniform quality and clarity, consistent wit h the overall printing, and the final appearance shall conform to the pre-production sample ap proved by the Institute. Part B – Pre-Production Sample (After Award of Contract Only) 5. Submission of any physical sample along with the bid is not required. 6. The successful seller shall submit one physical pre-production sample to the Institute within thr ee days of receipt of the print-ready artwork. The Institute shall either communicate its approval or provide a consolidated list of required modifications within two days of receipt of the sample. 7. The seller shall commence bulk printing only after obtaining written approval of the pre-production s ample from the Institute. Any bulk production undertaken prior to such approval shall be entirely at t he seller's own risk and cost. 8. In the event of any delay on the part of the Institute in providing the artwork or communicating appr oval of the sample beyond the timelines specified in Clauses 3 and 6 respectively, the delivery perio d shall be extended by an equivalent number of days through the delivery-period extension facility o n the GeM portal, and no liquidated damages shall be imposed on the seller for such delay attributa

ble to the Institute. 9. In case the submitted sample materially deviates from the contractual requirements, the Institute m ay require the seller to submit one revised sample for approval. In the event of continued non-compli ance, the Institute shall be entitled to take appropriate action in accordance with the applicable prov isions of the GeM General Terms and Conditions (GTC). 10. Once the sample has been approved, the seller shall not make any change in the paper quality, GSM , dimensions, printing, layout, font, logo, page numbering or ruling without obtaining prior written ap proval from the Institute. Part C – Quality Requirements 11. The paper used shall be new, clean, white and uniform in quality, conforming to the specified GSM. I t shall be suitable for writing with ordinary pen and ink and shall not exhibit excessive show-through or transparency. 12. All printing shall be clear, sharp, properly aligned and consistent, with correct front-to-back registrati on. The printed material shall be free from smudging, ghosting, double printing, ink spreading or tra nsfer. 13. All ruling lines and margins shall be straight, continuous, uniform and strictly in accordance with the approved sample. 14. Page numbers and VAMNICOM logos shall be clear, legible, correctly positioned and uniform through out all pages of every answer book supplied. Part D – Documents to be Submitted Along with the Bid 15. Experience: The bidder shall upload a copy of at least one relevant supply order, along with docum entary proof of successful delivery (such as CRAC / delivery acceptance certificate), issued by any C entral Government or State Government organisation or Public Sector Undertaking (PSU), for the sup ply of Examination Answer Books or similar printed stationery during the preceding financial year. 16. Past Performance: The bidder shall upload copies of relevant supply orders, along with document ary evidence of successful delivery, establishing that the bidder has supplied at least 30,000 (Thirt y Thousand) Examination Answer Books or similar printed stationery items, i.e. 50% of th e bid quantity of 60,000, to any Central / State Government organisation or PSU in any one of the preceding three financial years. 17. Exemption: Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) and DPIIT-recognised Startups claiming exemption from the Experience and Turnover criteria, as provided in the bid, shall upload a valid Udyam Registr ation Certificate or DPIIT recognition certificate, as applicable. No exemption is available from the Pa st Performance criterion under Clause 16. 18. Technical Compliance: The bidder shall upload the product data sheet or a duly signed undertakin g confirming compliance with all technical specifications and requirements of the bid, including Clau se 4 of this ATC. 19. Confidentiality Undertaking: The bidder shall upload a duly signed confidentiality undertaking in the format given in Part H of this ATC. 20. Make in India: The bidder shall submit a self-declaration regarding local content in accordance wit h the applicable Make in India provisions and the requirements of the bid. Part E – Delivery and Packaging 21. Delivery Period: The successful bidder shall complete the supply and delivery of the entire quantit y of 60,000 (Sixty Thousand) Examination Answer Books within 15 (Fifteen) days from the date of award of contract at: VAMNICOM Bhavan, Ganeshkhind Road, Pune – 411007, Mah arashtra. The cost of transportation, unloading and delivery of the material at the Institute's Store S ection shall be borne entirely by the seller. The delivery period shall be subject to extension, wherev er applicable, in accordance with Clause 8. 22. The Examination Answer Books shall be packed in properly counted packets of 100 books per pac ket. The packaging shall adequately protect the books against moisture, dust, damage, folding and other handling-related defects. Each packet shall be clearly labelled with the quantity contained ther ein. Part F – Inspection and Acceptance 23. The supplied Examination Answer Books shall be inspected at the consignee's premises with referen ce to the GeM category specifications, the contractual requirements and the pre-production sample approved by the Institute. 24. The Institute reserves the right to reject any Examination Answer Books found defective or not confo rming to the contractual requirements, including but not limited to:

(a) Printing defects, smudging, misalignment or poor print quality; (b) Missing, incorrect or improperly arranged pages; (c) Missing, repeated, incorrect or improperly printed page numbers; (d) Missing, distorted, incorrectly positioned or improperly printed VAMNICOM logos; (e) Incorrect dimensions or GSM; (f) Stains, folds, tears or any other physical damage; and (g) Any deviation from the approved sample or stipulated specifications. 25. Rejected or defective Examination Answer Books shall be replaced by the seller, at its own cost, wit hin 10 days from the date of communication of rejection. Acceptance or rejection shall be rec orded on the GeM portal within the timelines prescribed under GeM GTC, and the Consignee Receipt and Acceptance Certificate (CRAC) shall be issued after satisfactory inspection and acceptance of th e supplied quantity. 26. Liquidated damages, payment terms and termination of contract shall be governed by the GeM Gen eral Terms and Conditions (GTC) and other relevant contractual provisions. Part G – Invoice and Sub-Contracting 27. The invoice shall be raised in the name of the Registrar, VAMNICOM, incorporating the Institute's valid GSTIN. The seller shall upload the scanned GST-compliant tax invoice and proof of GST paymen t/deposit on the GeM portal. 28. The seller shall not assign, transfer or sub-contract the awarded contract, wholly or partially, without prior written consent of the Institute. Notwithstanding any such permitted arrangement, the seller sh all remain fully responsible for the satisfactory execution of all contractual obligations. Part H – Confidentiality Undertaking (Format) UNDERTAKING REGARDING CONFIDENTIALITY AND RESTRICTED USE OF INSTITUTE'S MATERIAL I/We, M/s. ______________________________, hereby undertake that all formats, artwork, logos, designs, text a nd other material provided by the Vaikunth Mehta National Institute of Co-operative Management (VAMNIC OM), Pune, in connection with GeM Bid No. GEM/2026/B/________________, shall be used exclusively for the execution of the present contract. I/We further undertake that: 1. The above material shall not be reproduced, disclosed, shared, transferred or used for any other pur pose without the prior written permission of the Institute. 2. All surplus printed material, rejected prints, extra copies and digital files containing the Institute's ar twork or other material shall be destroyed or permanently deleted after completion of the supply. 3. No copy of the Institute's artwork, logo, formats or designs shall be retained, circulated or used for a ny commercial or other purpose. I/We confirm that the above conditions shall be strictly complied with, and that any breach of this undertak ing shall render us liable for appropriate action as per the applicable contractual provisions and law.
